title: Autoreview findings bundle
description: Structured output contract for the autoreview reviewer. The reviewer MUST return exactly one object matching this schema and nothing else (no Markdown, no prose wrapper).

findings.description: Actionable defects only. Empty array means clean review. Do not pad with generic or stylistic noise.

body.description: Concrete explanation: what is wrong, why it matters, the evidence path the reviewer followed, and the ownership boundary. No speculation.

priority.description: P0 = blocker (data loss, crash, security exposure, broken install/upgrade). P1 = should fix before merge. P2 = worth fixing. P3 = minor/nit.

confidence.description: Reviewer confidence that the finding is real and actionable, grounded in the read code.

category.description: bug = logic/correctness defect; security = concrete actionable risk or removed safety check; regression = behavior change vs prior contract; test_gap = missing or insufficient coverage for the change; maintainability = real maintainability risk; style = actionable inconsistency with repo conventions; documentation = missing/incorrect docs or contracts for the changed surface.

file_path.description: Repo-relative path as it appears in the diff.

line.description: First line of the defect in the new version of the file.

end_line.description: Optional last line of the affected range.

suggested_fix.description: Objective, actionable fix scoped to the smallest ownership boundary. State the change, not a broad rewrite. May be rejected if a fix would over-complicate the codebase.

overall_correctness.description: Verdict for the reviewed change bundle as a whole.

overall_explanation.description: Short rationale for the overall verdict, referencing the highest-priority findings.
